answer: Sybils can be stopped with an escrowed task bond: a newcomer locks 300 POA and earns it back by real work. The bond is the only inlet: one identity per bond, no batch entry. It must pass 30 verified tasks in 30 days, each checked by 2 established peers and signed on its ivory page. At the zenith of the 30 days the bond unlocks only if every task passed; one failed audit freezes it and bars the identity. Forging 10,000 fakes locks 3,000,000 POA for a month and needs 300,000 tasks and 600,000 peer audits. Like a toll bridge, not an open field: every fake pays in tokens and a month of work.
